test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following states is the most urbanised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, Goa is the most urbanized state, with about **62.2%** of its population living in urban areas (Census 2011).
 
• Tamil Nadu had the highest urbanization rate among large states at **48.4%**, followed by Maharashtra and Gujarat.
 
• Notably, Kerala had a rapid increase in urbanization between 2001 and 2011, with **47.7%** of its population urbanized, primarily due to the reclassification of rural areas.
 
• Punjab had **37.5%** urbanization, while Himachal Pradesh remained one of the least urbanized states with just **10%** of its population living in urban areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2023 Estimates:** As per recent estimates, India's urban population is about **35-38%** of the total population. States like Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Gujarat continue to lead in urbanization.
 
• **Kerala & Goa:** Both states have seen further increases in urbanization due to development and tourism.
 
• The first full census in India was conducted in **1881** under British rule.
 
• In the **1881** Census of India, the **Madras Presidency** (now part of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Kerala) was among the most urbanized regions.
 
• The first regular census in India was conducted in **1872** by British administrator **W.C. Plowden**. However, it was not synchronous across the entire country and is considered a **partial census.**
 
• **Mumbai** remains one of the most urbanized cities in India, with a population of over **20 million** (2023 estimates).
